lines.t: Call on me, I will answer. Lean on me, I will supply.
Fly in this world, you'll face the storms
But I've overcome, so rest your heart tonight
Before the trouble ever found you
I was standing in the gap
Before the weight was on your shoulders
I had grace already mapped
Nothing quaking now surprises me
I moved early from my place
Every need you haven't spoken yet
Is already met by grace
Call on me
I will answer
Lean on me
I will supply
In this world you'll face the storms
That I've overcome
So rest your heart tonight
When your strength feels insufficient
When the never-refuses dawn
Remember this, my power works best
Where you think you're weak and gone
You don't have to hold together
What I never asked you to
Just stay near and let my presence
Do what only I can do
Peace I give you
Not the kind the world can take
Grace that holds you
When the ground begins to shake
You will hear the thunder roll
You will feel the pressure rise
But be still, I've already won this fight
Call on me
I will answer
Lean on me
I will supply
In this world you'll face the storms
But I've overcome
So rest your heart tonight
I am with you
I am the great I am
You're never alone
Call on me
Hey! I will answer you. Lean on me. Hey! I will survive.
In this world you'll face the storms
But I've overcome
So rest your heart tonight
